title: Luxury 4BR Home w/ Game Room, 10 Beds & Nash Vibes
description:
Brand New Listing! Perfect place for your bachelor and bachelorette party! Modern 4BR/4BA East Nashville retreat with 10 beds, rooftop lounge, and game room. Perfect for groups up to 12, this stylish home offers spacious living, premium amenities, and quick access to Broadway, The Gulch, and Nissan Stadium. Ideal for family gatherings, celebrations, or business stays in Music City.

The space
Welcome to Your Luxury Nashville Escape!

This stunning 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom retreat is designed with comfort, style, and entertainment in mind—perfect for large groups, families, or friends looking to enjoy Music City in luxury. With 10 beds and a spacious layout, this home blends modern elegance with fun amenities for an unforgettable stay.

✨ Property Highlights
	•	4 Bedrooms | 10 Beds | 4 Bathrooms – comfortably sleeps large groups.
	•	Swanky Game Room – complete with a pool table, lounge seating, and plenty of space to gather.
	•	Fully Stocked Kitchen – stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and all the essentials to cook and entertain.
	•	Stylish Living Room – open-concept design with cozy seating and smart TV for movie nights or watching the big game.
	•	Private Outdoor Space – relax and enjoy Nashville evenings after a day of exploring.

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements
	•	Bedroom 1: King Bed + private ensuite bathroom
	•	Bedroom 2: King Bed + private ensuite bathroom
	•	Bedroom 3: Four Twin Beds (perfect for kids, teens, or singles) + Private ensuite bathroom 
	•	Bedroom 4: Four Queen Beds (great for groups or families sharing a room) + Private ensuite bathroom 

🚿 Bathrooms

Each of the four full bathrooms is modern and spacious, equipped with walk-in showers, sleek vanities, and luxury finishes—ensuring comfort and privacy for everyone in your group.

🎲 Game Room Fun

The highlight of the home is the swanky game room—decked out with a full-size pool table, lounge area, and entertainment setup. It’s the perfect spot to unwind, compete, and create memories without ever leaving the house.

📍 Prime Location

Located just minutes from Downtown Nashville, Broadway’s famous honky-tonks, and Nashville’s best dining, shopping, and entertainment. Whether you’re here for live music, nightlife, or a relaxing getaway, you’ll be right in the heart of it all.

⸻

🔥 This home is tailor-made for bachelor/ette parties, family trips, and group getaways—offering the space, style, and entertainment to make your Nashville stay unforgettable.

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

If you have any questions, just message us anytime!  Happy to help!

STR Permit#:2025-06-6662

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire property, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, rooftop lounge, and game room. Self-check-in via smart lock ensures a seamless arrival.
